ios-content|Image views.summary: A Plenix image on iOS is the system image view in a frame of a fixed ratio from the Plenix aspect-ratio scale: the picture fills the frame (scaledToFill) or shows whole (scaledToFit) on the neutral fill, and a remote picture shows that fill while it loads and the image symbol with “Image not available” when it fails. Corners are square inside a card and the media radius when the picture stands alone. VoiceOver reads its label; a decorative picture is hidden from it.

variants.name: Cover (default)
variants.swiftui: .resizable().scaledToFill() in a frame with .aspectRatio(4 / 3, contentMode: .fit) and .clipped()
variants.use: Thumbnails and previews in a grid of one ratio.

variants.name: Contain
variants.use: Logos, documents and drawings that must not be cropped.

variants.name: Rounded
variants.appkit: layer?.cornerRadius = Plenix.Radius.radiusMedia4px (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)
variants.use: A picture standing alone in content.

variants.name: Error fallback
variants.swiftui: AsyncImage phase .failure: the photo symbol and “Image not available”
variants.uikit: the image view shows the fallback view when the download fails
variants.appkit: NSImageView with the fallback image (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)
variants.use: Every remote picture that can fail to load.

anatomy.name: Frame
anatomy.about: The box with its ratio from the aspect-ratio scale; it keeps its size before the picture arrives.

anatomy.name: Picture
anatomy.about: The image, cropped to the frame or shown whole.

anatomy.name: Fallback
anatomy.about: The photo symbol and “Image not available” on the neutral fill when the picture fails.

attributes.appkit: layer?.backgroundColor from fillNeutral (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

attributes.appkit: layer?.cornerRadius (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

attributes.value: The muted content color in DM Sans (Plenix.Colors.contentMuted)
attributes.appkit: NSTextField label with the muted color (a macOS build of the tokens is needed)

states.uikit: the download failed: the fallback view shows
